subject: Cloud Computing
title: Misconfiguration: The Top Threat
description: A short lesson to help you apply Misconfiguration: The Top Threat.

hook.text: Capital One lost 100 million customer records in 2019. The cause? A misconfigured firewall rule.

buildup.text: Misconfiguration is the number one cloud security threat. Open storage buckets, weak IAM, exposed ports.

discovery.text: Cloud Security Posture Management tools scan for misconfigurations automatically and flag risks.

twist.text: Teams fix misconfigurations, then someone deploys a new resource and reintroduces the same mistake.

climax.text: Prevention beats detection. Enforce security policies in code so misconfigurations can't be deployed.

punchline.text: The biggest cloud threat isn't hackers. It's misconfiguration.

quiz.question: What caused the Capital One data breach in 2019?
options: A misconfigured firewall rule that exposed customer data
A physical break-in at an AWS data center
An employee intentionally leaking data to competitors

details.summary: Cloud misconfiguration is the leading cause of cloud security incidents, including exposed storage buckets, overly permissive firewalls, and unencrypted databases. The flexibility that makes cloud powerful also makes it easy to accidentally leave dangerous defaults in place.
details.whyItMatters: Attackers systematically scan for common misconfigurations. A single exposed bucket or open port can lead to massive data breaches affecting millions of records.
takeaways: Misconfiguration is the number one cloud security threat
Common errors include public storage and open security groups
Automated scanning tools detect misconfigurations continuously

faq.question: What are the most common cloud misconfigurations?
faq.answer: Publicly accessible storage buckets, security groups allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on all ports, unencrypted databases, disabled logging, over-permissioned IAM roles, and default credentials left unchanged. Each of these has caused headline-making breaches.

faq.question: How can misconfigurations be prevented?
faq.answer: Use infrastructure as code with security linting, enable cloud security posture management tools that scan continuously, enforce guardrails through organizational policies, and require peer review for all infrastructure changes before deployment.
